description: MtaStsMode is pub enum in config.rs with three variants (None, Testing, Enforce). RFC 8461 was written with room for future modes; if a new variant is added later, callers who match on MtaStsMode exhaustively will get a compile error rather than a 'catch unknown modes' warning. #[non_exhaustive] is the idiomatic Rust solution: it forces external callers to add a wildcard arm, making the addition non-breaking. MtaStsPolicy { pub mode: MtaStsMode } is also pub, so this surface will escape into external code.
title: MtaStsMode public enum missing #[non_exhaustive]
